the batch pipeline example should guarantee empty cells for failed fields rather than empty strings."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction section lacks a locale/priority rule for Malaysian/SG DD/MM/YYYY receipts and does not recommend a plausibility check (e.g., prefer DD/MM/YYYY unless day>12 forces interpretation; no fallback to a second preprocessing/PSM pass when the extracted total is implausible (e.g., not matching any item/subtotal arithmetic)."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Does not reinforce that string-typed columns (like total_amount as 2-decimal string) must preserve None vs '' distinction; Also run a second OCR pass (different PSM/preprocessing) when the chosen total is implausible."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document that number parsing must strip currency prefixes (RM, $) and thousands commas, then format via f'{v:.2f}'; and that the stored cell type must remain string with object dtype to preserve e.g. '20.00' rather than 20.0."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add explicit section for OCR-style outputs: when a column must be a 2-decimal string with optional nulls, use object dtype, write None (not '') on failure, and verify by reloading the file and asserting cells are either strings matching r'^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$' or truly empty."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a verification pattern: after writing stat_ocr.xlsx, reload with pandas, check column set == {filename,date,total_amount}, row order equals sorted(filename), and that empty cells are NaN/None rather than '' or 'None'."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'summary region' heuristic: locate the first line after items (e.g., where 'SUBTOTAL'/'SUB-TOTAL'/'ITEM COUNT'/'TOT QTY' appears) and restrict total-keyword matching to lines at/after that index. This reduces false matches on header lines like 'Qty Price Amount' and item rows."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document common OCR failure modes for Malaysian receipts (RM prefix, comma thousands, rounding to nearest 0.05, 6% GST lines, 'Nett Total' spelling) and provide a reference regex set generalizable beyond the sample."}],"confidence":"medium"}
